description: A `struct` type name colliding with the keyword `mod` raises `ol-reserved-word` at phase-1 registration, `stage: "semantic"` -- `execute()` runs `check()` before Phase 2 (issue #815), so the runtime carries its own declaration-slot guard (`execute-internal.ts`'s `registerDeclarations`; `spec/data-structures.md:323` gives `struct` the `ol-reserved-word` and `ol-duplicate-definition` diagnostics and phase-1 registration, and `:304` states the split this fixture turns on: "Field names are bindings, not declarations, so any name is legal there ... The type name is a declaration: it registers a constructor in the callable namespace, so a built-in name raises `ol-reserved-word`"). `mod` collides here exactly as `struct and` does (`spec/grammar.md:373,378` -- `and`/`or`/`not`/`mod` are word-spelled operators of the expression grammar, not callable primitives). Note the field list `[ x y ]` is a binding position and stays unrestricted. The check-stage and binding/call axes are pinned by core-language/check/reserved-word-define-mod and keyword-mod-binds-and-calls-freely. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists, but it runs only under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — NOT in this fixture, which is checked — and when it does run it is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy never appears beside the check's. So nothing here observes that copy, and reading this fixture as evidence for it would be a mistake: measured, a runtime guard can be deleted outright with the whole conformance corpus still green, because the surviving report is the check's either way. What the runtime copy uniquely contributes is that the run STOPS at the fault, which is written in the event stream rather than in the diagnostics and is pinned by `packages/runtime/src/runtime-guards-halt.test.mjs`.

diagnostics.message: mod is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
